device_entry.name: 电动滤光片转轮
tags: 显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 一款多工位电动滤光片转轮，可在多个滤光片位置之间快速切换。常用于显微成像、荧光实验和光学测量中，以选择不同波段或不同类型的光学滤片。
device_entry.description_en: A multi-position motorized filter wheel that switches quickly between installed optical filters. It is commonly used in microscopy, fluorescence experiments, and optical measurements to select different wavelength bands or filter types.

schema.description_en: Get the current filter wheel position.
